svg.desc: A positive bounded rate is fitted against seven synthetic perturbed observations of reservoir A. The objective and fitted curve use the exact solution of the declared model, isolating parameter fitting from integration error. A small residual does not validate equal-volume exchange assumptions.
svg.title: A bounded exchange-rate fit
